mentions.name: Visor
mentions.description: Visor is a new type of trading terminal centered around options and gamma exposure (gex). Its main feature is overlaying the options payout graph directly on the chart — described as like tastytrade rotated 90° and put on a live barchart — so traders can watch all the Greeks play out in real time.
mentions.problem: Options traders lack a terminal that overlays the options payout graph and Greeks directly on the live price chart.
mentions.audience: Options traders who want to see options payoff and Greeks visualized on a live chart
mentions.author: GageBachik

supporting.summary: The commenter reports the tool has been instrumental in deeply understanding the dynamics of more advanced options trades.
supporting.excerpt: Has been instrumental in me deeply understanding the dynamics of more advanced options trades.
supporting.author: GageBachik
